name: Food Traceability & Batch Tracking Log
primary_keyword: food traceability log template batch tracking
secondary_keywords: one step back one step forward food traceability
commercial kitchen batch code tracking sheet
search_intent: Food manufacturers, wholesalers, caterers, and commercial kitchens creating a compliant batch tracking and traceability log satisfying UK General Food Law (Regulation EC 178/2002 Article 18) and US FSMA Rule 204, tracking Key Data Elements (KDEs) across Critical Tracking Events (CTEs) from farm/supplier intake to customer dispatch.

competitors.title: FSMA Final Rule on Food Traceability | FDA
competitors.weaknesses: Dense legalistic prose, lacks usable day-to-day spreadsheet or browser-based tracking tool.

competitors.title: Traceability and Recall Guidance | FSS
competitors.strengths: Clear UK regulatory principles on Article 18.
competitors.weaknesses: Static text guidance, no interactive batch logging or mock recall timer.

competitors.title: Food Traceability Checklist & Log | SafetyCulture
competitors.weaknesses: App download paywall, lacks mock recall reconciliation audit features.

competitors.title: Food Traceability Log Template | FoodDocs
competitors.weaknesses: Requires paid software plan, no free downloadable CSV or printable sheet.

competitors.title: Guide to Food Traceability | High Speed Training
competitors.weaknesses: Informational blog, no practical interactive logging system.

gap_analysis.what_they_have: Dense government legal texts or paywalled software subscriptions.
gap_analysis.what_they_lack: An ungated, interactive digital batch tracking log supporting one-step-back supplier intake, internal batch transformation, and one-step-forward dispatch with CSV export.
gap_analysis.what_we_offer: Interactive Food Traceability Log tool with intake batch logging, internal production batch codes, dispatch verification, mock recall timer, and instant CSV export.
